documents.title: Changelog
documents.body: All notable changes to pagify. The format is based on Keep a Changelog , and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning . Release Types Type Description Added New features Changed Changes in existing functionality Deprecated Soon-to-be removed features Removed Removed features Fixed Bug fixes Security Vulnerability fixes Links GitHub Releases GitHub Commits Releases v0.0.1 — December 1, 2023 v0.0.2 — December 20, 2023 v0.0.3 — January 5, 2024 v0.1.0 — January 15, 2024 v0.2.0 — March 1, 2024 v0.3.0 — May 15, 2024 v1.0.0 — September 1, 2024 v2.0.0 — February 10, 2025 v3.0.0 — October 1, 2025

documents.title: v0.0.1
documents.body: Released: December 1, 2023 Added First prototype — Skeleton CLI with a single build command Markdown discovery — Walk a directory and collect .md files Basic HTML rendering — Wrap Markdown in a minimal static page Go CLI — Cobra-based command tree with --output Fixed N/A (first prototype) Security N/A (first prototype) Related Changelog home v0.0.2 — next release Initial prototype. Not for production use.

documents.title: v0.0.2
documents.body: Released: December 20, 2023 Added Themes — Pluggable template + asset tree, embedded via go:embed Navigation — Generated from the file tree; index.md becomes a section landing page Link rewriting — .md links rewritten to clean URLs Frontmatter — Page metadata: title, description, order, label, draft Site config — pagify.yaml at the content root Fixed Output directory now cleared before each build so deleted pages do not survive Security N/A Related Changelog home v0.0.1 — previous release v0.0.3 — next release

documents.title: v0.0.3
documents.body: Released: January 5, 2024 Added Search index — Client-side search over a generated search-index.json Callouts — GitHub-style > [!NOTE] , > [!TIP] , > [!WARNING] , > [!DANGER] Preview server — pagify preview rebuilds on every request Goldmark v2 — GFM, footnotes, auto heading IDs, raw HTML passthrough Dark/light theme — Automatic OS detection with manual toggle Fixed Sidebar now takes full viewport height on all browsers Callout aliases ( info , success , check , caution , attention , error ) accepted Security N/A Related Changelog home v0.0.2 — previous release v0.1.0 — next release

documents.title: v0.1.0
documents.body: Released: January 15, 2024 Added Zero-configuration builds — Point at a directory of Markdown files, get a complete site GitHub-flavored Markdown — Tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes Callouts — > [!NOTE] , > [!TIP] , > [!WARNING] , > [!DANGER] with aliases Built-in search — Client-side search index, no backend required Dark/light theme — Automatic OS detection, manual toggle, localStorage persistence Responsive design — Sidebar on desktop, drawer on mobile Syntax highlighting — Via CSS, no JavaScript required Cross-page links — .md links rewritten to clean URLs Frontmatter — Page metadata (title, description, order, label, draft) Site config via frontmatter — title, language, basePath, theme, footer in index.md Local dev server — pagify preview with live rebuild MCP server — pagify mcp for AI tool integration Single binary — Embedded assets, no Node.js, no runtime dependencies Fixed N/A (initial release) Security N/A (initial release) Related Changelog home v0.0.3 — previous release v0.2.0 — next release First public release.

documents.title: v0.2.0
documents.body: Released: March 1, 2024 Added Graph command — pagify graph scans Markdown and emits a link graph Interactive HTML visualization — Offline vis-network graph view JSON graph export — --format json for renderer-independent data Graph dot export — --format dot for Graphviz Obsidian-inspired theme — Dark palette, purple nodes, force-directed layout Graph search and inspection — Search, hover tooltips, connected-file details Changed pagify graph defaults to writing graph.dot , graph.json and graph.html Fixed Graph output directory paths now resolve correctly Security N/A Related Changelog home v0.1.0 — previous release v0.3.0 — next release

documents.title: v0.3.0
documents.body: Released: May 15, 2024 Added Wikilink extraction — [[target]] , [[target|alias]] , [[target#frag]] Standard Markdown link extraction — [text](target) alongside wikilinks Extensionless link resolution — [Guide](guide/index) resolves to guide/index.md Fenced code block skipping — Links inside ``` blocks are ignored Broken link detection — Unresolved targets are marked, not silently dropped Outside-root detection — Links escaping the scan root are reported Duplicate edge removal — Normalized unordered pairs collapse Deterministic ordering — Nodes and edges sorted before serialization Changed Graph extractor refactored into internal/graph with separate renderer Fixed Nested fenced code blocks now parse correctly Security N/A Related Changelog home v0.2.0 — previous release v1.0.0 — next major release

documents.title: v1.0.0
documents.body: Released: September 1, 2024 Added Stable API — Public command surface is now frozen Plugin system — Hooks for custom themes, renderers and link resolvers Multi-language support — language frontmatter and i18n navigation pagify check — Link validation command OpenAPI docs — pagify serve exposes /api/v1/openapi.json and Swagger UI Workspace confinement — --root bounds all file access for the API server Changed pagify serve replaces the preview server as the API entry point Theme assets now copied through fs.FS rather than walking directories Fixed API server no longer reads outside its --root Navigation groups with no index.md render correctly Security All content paths resolved through internal/workspace Related Changelog home v0.3.0 — previous release v2.0.0 — next release server Package — API server site Package — navigation and discovery

documents.title: v2.0.0
documents.body: Released: February 10, 2025 Added Pluggable architecture — Themes, renderers and resolvers are now first-class extensions Custom themes — Embed a template + asset tree and resolve it by name in build.Build Plugin hooks — Before/after build, before/after render, custom link resolution Asset tree API — fs.FS -based asset copying with no directory walking Config validation — pagify.yaml is validated against a schema; unparsable configs fail loudly Changed internal/theme replaces the monolithic default theme with a composable Theme type internal/build restructured around loadSite and writePages pagify preview rebuilds on every request instead of watching the filesystem Removed Legacy serve command (replaced by pagify serve with OpenAPI) Security N/A Related Changelog home v1.0.0 — previous release v3.0.0 — next release theme Package — theme architecture build Package — build pipeline

documents.title: v3.0.0
documents.body: Released: October 1, 2025 Added MCP server — pagify mcp exposes pagify as an AI tool over Model Context Protocol Workspace confinement — Every content path resolved through internal/workspace , so the API cannot read outside --root OpenAPI 3.1 — /api/v1/openapi.json and Swagger UI at /api/v1/docs Health endpoint — /api/v1/health for load balancers and CI In-memory build — POST /api/v1/build renders one page without writing to disk Frontmatter-driven config — Site-wide settings live in index.md frontmatter Changed pagify serve is the single API entry point; preview is a thin wrapper All file access confined to --root Security All content paths resolved through internal/workspace Related Changelog home v2.0.0 — previous release server Package — API server and MCP build Package — build pipeline
